analects-03.why: 3.9 杞不足徵也: the Kanripo Siku transcription prints 把 (also in Zhu Xi's comment, 把夏之後); Ruan 1816 and He Yan SBCK both have 杞, the state of Qi, heirs of Xia. The sense allows only 杞.

analects-04.why: 4.14 不患莫己知: the Kanripo Siku transcription prints 已 (the copy confuses 己/已/巳 throughout); Zhu Xi's comment on the line has 求其在己者, the first collation witness reads 己, He Yan SBCK has 巳 (its form for both). The sense ('no one knows me') allows only 己.

analects-05.why: 5.9 宰予晝寢: the Kanripo Siku transcription prints 宰子 (子/予 confusion; Zhu Xi's comment on the line names 宰予, and the Master goes on 於予與何誅, calling him by his name 予); Ruan 1816 and He Yan SBCK both read 宰予. The sense allows only 宰予.
5.15 其行己也恭: the Kanripo Siku transcription prints 已 (the copy confuses 己/已/巳, as at 4.14); the first collation witness reads 己. 'In conducting himself' allows only 己.

analects-06.why: 6.28 己欲立而立人，己欲達而達人 'wishing to stand himself, he sets others up; wishing to get through himself, he gets others through': the Kanripo Siku transcription prints 已 for the first 己 and 巳 for the second (the copy confuses 己/已/巳, as at 4.14 and 5.15); Master Cheng, quoted in Zhu Xi's comment on the passage, writes 己欲立而立人己欲達而達人, and the first collation witness (KR1h0004) reads 己 both times. The sense allows only 己. One entry covers both characters because the build allows one note-opening per unit.

analects-07.why: 7.28 人潔己以進 'a man purifies himself to come forward': the Kanripo Siku transcription prints 已 (the copy confuses 己/已/巳 throughout, as at 4.14, 5.15, 6.28; Zhu Xi's comment on the line has 潔巳, the same confusion); the first collation witness (KR1h0004) reads 絜己. The sense allows only 己.

analects-08.why: 8.4 鳥之將死，其鳴也哀 'when a bird is about to die, its cry is mournful': the Kanripo Siku transcription prints 其鳴地哀 (地 for 也, a graphic confusion of the two forms), breaking the parallel with 其言也善 in the next clause; Ruan 1816 (KR1h0004) and He Yan SBCK (KR1h0005) both read 其鳴也哀. The sense allows only 也.

analects-09.why: 9.5 匡人其如予何: the Kanripo Siku transcription prints 如子何 (子/予 confusion, as at 5.9); Zhu Xi's comment on the line paraphrases 匡人其奈我何 'what can the men of Kuang do to me', and Ruan 1816 and He Yan SBCK both read 予 (He Yan's Ma Rong: 如予何者，猶言奈我何也). The sense allows only 予.

9.11 且予縱不得大葬，予死於道路乎: the Kanripo Siku transcription prints 子 for the second 予 (子/予 confusion, as at 5.9 and 9.5); Ruan 1816 and He Yan SBCK both read 予, and the sentence's subject is the Master himself (且予縱不得大葬…). The sense allows only 予.
